horizon.pages.settings.tooltip: Volt's own settings: Volt Boost, graphics, waypoints, minimal minimap, controllers, extras and mods.
horizon.pages.waypoints.tooltip: 3D world waypoints, beacon beams, death markers, 8x Nether sync and per-world/server pin manager (off by default).
horizon.pages.minimap.tooltip: Minimal live world minimap with entity radar, waypoint pins, cave/surface slicing, chunk grid and HUD readouts (off by default).
horizon.pages.graphics.tooltip: Graphics, simply: each setting says what it costs.
horizon.pages.graphics_advanced.tooltip: Every graphics setting, Volt's included, with what each costs.
horizon.pages.controller.tooltip: Controllers: their buttons, sticks, vibration and menu navigation.
horizon.pages.extras.tooltip: Optional Volt additions, all off by default: the game stays vanilla until you turn one on.
horizon.pages.agent.tooltip: Let your own AI agent play Volt on this device.
horizon.pages.shader_packs.tooltip: Shader packs from the shaderpacks folder: Volt's own and those in the shaders/ format. One runs at a time.
horizon.pages.mods.tooltip: Mods made for Volt, from the horizon-mods folder. Each runs in a sandbox and stays off until you turn it on.
horizon.mods.empty: No mods: put .hmod files in the horizon-mods folder
horizon.shader_packs.empty: No shader packs: put them in the shaderpacks folder

volt.boost.title: Volt Boost — Performance & Optimization
volt.boost.tooltip: Volt Boost: Tier 1-3 FPS, GPU, CPU, RAM, entity, chunk, particle & thermal optimizations (all off by default).
volt.shaders.title: Volt Shaders
volt.shaders.tooltip: Built-in native WGSL Volt Shaders tuned for maximum mobile FPS (off by default).
volt.shaders.opt.wind_speed.tooltip: Controls how fast waving grass, leaves and crops sway in the wind.
volt.shaders.opt.wind_strength.tooltip: Controls the displacement amplitude of waving plants, leaves and water.
volt.shaders.opt.shadow_richness.tooltip: Adjusts directional shadow contrast on faces turned away from the sun.
volt.shaders.opt.torch_intensity.tooltip: Controls block-light brightness emitted by torches, lanterns and campfires.
volt.shaders.opt.emissive_glow.tooltip: Boosts self-lit radiance on lava, fire, sea lanterns, glowstone and sculk.
volt.shaders.opt.water_reflection.toolti: Adjusts Fresnel sky reflection strength across water surfaces.
volt.shaders.opt.sunset_glow.tooltip: Adjusts warm golden-amber horizon radiance during sunrise and sunset.
volt.shaders.opt.vibrance.tooltip: Enriches muted colours while protecting already-saturated hues from clipping.
volt.shaders.opt.saturation.tooltip: Adjusts overall colour saturation across sky, water and terrain.
volt.shaders.opt.exposure.tooltip: Adjusts overall scene brightness before tonemapping.
volt.shaders.opt.warmth.tooltip: Shifts white balance toward warm golden sunlight or crisp cool moonlight.
volt.visuals.title: Volt Visuals — Shaders & World Aesthetics
volt.visuals.tooltip: Volt Shaders (BSL + Complementary engine), Connected Glass, Better Grass Sides, 3D Dropped Items & World Lighting.
volt.qol.title: Volt QoL — Inspector, Blueprint, Atlas, Viewmodel & Sound
volt.qol.tooltip: Optic Zoom & 360 Freelook, World Inspector, Spawn Light-0, 3D Blueprint, World Atlas, Volt JEI, Sound Physics Lite & Viewmodel Customizer.
volt.chat.title: Volt Chat — Chat Suite
volt.chat.tooltip: Built-in Chat Timestamps, Spam Stacker, Mention Ping & Quick-Chat Bar.
volt.mods.title: Volt Mods — 50 Built-In Pure-Rust Mods
volt.mods.tooltip: 50 zero-lag pure-Rust native mods across PvP & Utility, PvP HUD & Display, Visuals, Performance & Additional QoL.
volt.mod_menu.title: Mod Menu — 50 Native Rust Mods
volt.mod_menu.tooltip: Split-pane Mod Menu with custom logos, live ON/OFF switches, search, All/On/Off/Fav filters & per-mod settings.
volt.atlas.title: Volt World Atlas — Interactive Chunk Map
volt.atlas.tooltip: Full-screen persistent world map with Surface, Relief, Lush Biome & Slime Chunk modes plus 1-tap waypoint pinning.
